results.snippet:
| Plan | Price | Built for | What you get |
------|
| Free | $0 | Prototypes, learning, side projects | 2 active projects, shared CPU with 500 MB RAM, 500 MB database per project, community support |
| Pro | From $25/month | Launched apps | $10 compute credit, 8 GB disk per project, 100,000 MAU, daily backups kept 7 days, email support, no pausing | [...] | App | Setup | Example usage | Monthly bill |
------|
| Side project or prototype | Free, 1 project | Within every Free limit | $0 |
| Launched MVP | Pro, 1 project on Micro | 5,000 MAU, 1 GB database, 20 GB files, 40 GB egress | $25 |
| MVP with a staging copy | Pro, 2 projects on Micro | Same as above | $35 |
| Agency with 5 client apps | Pro, 5 projects on Micro | All within Pro quotas | $65 | [...] $0 on Free. On Pro, $25 a month for one project on Micro compute, plus about $10 for each extra project and any usage above the included quotas. In our examples, a launched MVP pays $25 to $35 a month, and a consumer app with 150,000 monthly active users pays about $275.
